_comment: PINNED ceyx native-decoder release consumed by scripts/build_apps.py.
The tag fixes WHICH GitHub release the Linux/Windows prebuilt libraries come
from; the per-asset sha256 fixes WHICH BYTES, because a tag can be moved and
an asset re-uploaded. build_apps.py downloads the asset directly by tag (no
GitHub API call, so anonymous rate limits cannot fail a pinned build) and
refuses to place a library whose sha256 does not match.
Each platform holds a LIST of libraries, not a single one. Windows ships
three: the decoder plus heif.dll and libde265.dll, which it dynamically imports
(LGPL-3 requires libheif/libde265 stay separate shared libraries -- see
ceyx native/third_party/heif-dist-windows/PROVENANCE.md). A Windows install
missing either dependency fails at DynamicLibrary.open with an error naming
only the decoder, so all three are fetched and verified together. Linux uses
a one-element list so there is exactly one code path.
This file is edited by hand OR, deliberately, by
`python3 scripts/build_apps.py --ceyx-release latest`, which resolves the
newest release, downloads its assets, records their real digests here, and
STOPS without building. The maintainer then reviews this diff and commits it.
An upstream release therefore cannot alter Halcyon's decoder without a
visible, reviewable change to this file.
sha256 provenance: pin moved to v0.1.5 on 2026-08-30 via
`python3 scripts/build_apps.py --ceyx-release latest`, which downloaded each
asset from https://github.com/jhangyu/ceyx/releases/download/v0.1.5/<asset>
and recorded the digests below; cross-checked by hand against the downloaded
assets with `shasum -a 256`. Trust-on-first-use (same authority that serves
the bytes): catches any FUTURE substitution, not one predating this date.
All three Windows digests are real values from the v0.1.5 release (Windows
HEIF round, docs/logs/2026-08-30/plan-windows-heif-impl.md).
macOS is intentionally ABSENT: its plugin vendors six interdependent dylibs
(decoder + lcms2 + jpeg + heif + de265 + omp) with install-name/codesign
wiring the release assets cannot satisfy. macOS keeps its committed
libraries. Android is out of scope for this pin.
